_doc: Item types. stack: max per slot. block: the block it places. tool: {kind, dur (uses), speed}. food: {hunger, thirst, cook (what it roasts into), cook_s (seconds on the fire)}. fuel: tinder | kindling | log. mats: tool parts and tools carry their stone ('stone' or 'flint') in their data, which sets durability.

stone.label: Stone
stone.desc: A fist-sized granite stone. Sneak and right-click it onto flat ground to knap it into a tool head.

flint.label: Flint
flint.desc: Glassy, hard flint. It knaps like stone but keeps a sharper edge: tools made from it last longer.

stick.label: Stick
stick.desc: Sticks come from leaves and fallen branches. Sneak and right-click one onto the ground to start a fire pit.

dry_grass.label: Dry grass
dry_grass.desc: Tall grass cut with a knife. Tinder for fires and pit kilns; four make a bundle of thatch.

plant_fiber.label: Plant fiber
plant_fiber.desc: Fiber from cattails, flax and ferns, cut with a knife. Twist three into twine.

twine.label: Twine
twine.desc: A length of twisted fiber, for bow drills.

clay.label: Clay
clay.desc: Blue clay dug from the pond's banks. Sneak and right-click it onto flat ground to shape pottery.

firewood.label: Firewood
firewood.desc: Split logs. Burns long and hot: what keeps a fire going through the night.

log_oak.label: Oak log
log_oak.desc: Split it into firewood with an axe in the crafting grid, or build with it.

log_birch.label: Birch log
log_birch.desc: Split it into firewood with an axe in the crafting grid, or build with it.

dirt.label: Soil
dirt.desc: Good for building and for farming.

gravel.label: Gravel
gravel.desc: Loose stones. Sometimes there is flint in it.

sand.label: Sand
sand.desc: Fine sand from the pond's edge.

thatch.label: Thatch
thatch.desc: Bundled dry grass. A light roof, or a bed.

brick_block.label: Fired bricks
brick_block.desc: Four fired bricks set together. Sturdy walls.

straw_bed.label: Straw bed
straw_bed.desc: Sleep on it to pass the night and wake there.

sapling_oak.label: Oak sapling
sapling_oak.desc: Plant it in soil and in a few days there will be a tree.

sapling_birch.label: Birch sapling
sapling_birch.desc: Plant it in soil and in a few days there will be a tree.

berry_bush.label: Blueberry bush
berry_bush.desc: Replant it on soil. It fruits again every couple of days.

torch.label: Torch
torch.desc: Unlit. Right-click a burning fire with it to light it.

torch_lit.label: Burning torch
torch_lit.desc: Light to carry, or place it. A burning torch lights a fire pit straight away.

knife_blade.label: Knife blade
knife_blade.desc: Knapped blade. Put it on a stick in the crafting grid.

axe_head.label: Axe head
axe_head.desc: Knapped axe head. Put it on a stick in the crafting grid.

shovel_head.label: Shovel head
shovel_head.desc: Knapped shovel blade. Put it on a stick in the crafting grid.

hoe_head.label: Hoe head
hoe_head.desc: Knapped hoe blade. Put it on a stick in the crafting grid.

knife.label: Knife
knife.desc: Cuts grass, cattails, flax and leaves.

shovel.label: Shovel
shovel.desc: Digs soil, clay, sand and gravel quickly.

hoe.label: Hoe
hoe.desc: Right-click soil to till it into farmland.

firestarter.label: Bow drill
firestarter.desc: Hold right-click on a fire pit or pit kiln that has tinder to light it.

bowl_raw.label: Raw clay bowl
bowl_raw.desc: Fire it in a pit kiln.

pot_raw.label: Raw cooking pot
pot_raw.desc: Fire it in a pit kiln.

jar_raw.label: Raw storage jar
jar_raw.desc: Fire it in a pit kiln.

brick_raw.label: Raw brick
brick_raw.desc: Fire it in a pit kiln.

bowl.label: Bowl
bowl.desc: Right-click water to fill it; hold right-click to drink. Ladle stew into it from a pot.

pot.label: Cooking pot
pot.desc: Fill it at the pond, set it on a fire pit and add food to make stew.

jar.label: Storage jar
jar.desc: Fired clay jar. Place it on the ground to keep things in it.

brick.label: Brick
brick.desc: Four make a block of fired bricks.

potsherd.label: Potsherds
potsherd.desc: What is left of a pot that cracked in the kiln. Put pottery in a pit, so it heats evenly.

charred_food.label: Charred food
charred_food.desc: Left on the fire too long.

seeds_flax.label: Flax seeds
seeds_flax.desc: Right-click farmland to sow. Flax gives fiber.

palm_log.label: Palm log
palm_log.desc: Light and straight: good raft timber. Split it into firewood with an axe, or build with it.

palm_frond.label: Palm frond
palm_frond.desc: A long palm leaf. Two make a bundle of thatch; dry, it catches fire easily.

coconut.label: Coconut
coconut.desc: Hold right click to drink the milk and eat the flesh. Fresh water where there is none.

seaweed.label: Seaweed
seaweed.desc: Salty. It fills you a little, but makes you thirsty.

sapling_palm.label: Palm sapling
sapling_palm.desc: Plant it in sand or soil and in a few days there will be a palm.
